definition_en: the plural of alumnus: former students of a school or university
core_image: 毕业多年的人回到校园，胸前别着校徽
scene: 毕业十年后，校友们回到礼堂参加校庆。Ten years after graduating, the alumni returned to the hall for the anniversary.
sceneCN: 这里指「校友（复数）」（第 1 个义项：一所学校已毕业的学生们）；句意：毕业十年后，校友们回到礼堂参加校庆。

senses.title: Former students
senses.definition: people who have graduated from the same school
senses.definitionCN: 从同一所学校毕业的人
senses.example: The alumni fund a scholarship each year.
senses.exampleCN: 校友们每年资助一项奖学金。
senses.why: Latin alumnus meant a foster child or pupil, so the plural names those the school once raised.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 alumnus 指被抚养的孩子或学生，复数就指学校曾培养过的人。

senses.title: Graduates as a group
senses.definition: the body of graduates treated as one community
senses.definitionCN: 被视作一个共同体的毕业生整体
senses.example: The alumni of that department work across three continents.
senses.exampleCN: 那个系的毕业生分布在三块大陆。
senses.why: A plural noun used as a collective names the group rather than individuals.
senses.whyCN: 复数名词作集合名词时，指的是群体而不是个人。

senses.title: Loose singular use
senses.definition: a common but disputed use of alumni for a single graduate
senses.definitionCN: 把 alumni 当作单数使用，常见但有争议
senses.example: Some style guides reject alumni for one person.
senses.exampleCN: 有些体例手册不接受用 alumni 指一个人。
senses.why: English speakers often treat Latin plurals as singular, which style guides resist.
senses.whyCN: 英语使用者常把拉丁复数当单数用，体例手册对此有保留。

intro.en: Alumni is the Latin plural of alumnus, a pupil or foster child.
intro.cn: alumni 是 alumnus（学生、被抚养者）的拉丁语复数。

items.en: Alumnus means a foster child or pupil.
items.cn: alumnus 意为被抚养的孩子或学生。

items.en: Universities adopt alumni for their graduates.
items.cn: 大学用 alumni 指本校毕业生。

items.en: The word now marks a lifelong tie to a school.
items.cn: 这个词如今标记与学校的一生联系。

note.en: Alumni belongs with alumnus, alumna, and graduate words.

entries.definition: a person who has finished a degree

normalIntro.en: Alumni is the plural: many graduates, one community.
normalIntro.cn: alumni 是复数：许多毕业生，一个共同体。

normal.en: The alumni association raised money for the library.
normal.cn: 校友会为图书馆筹了款。

normal.en: She met old alumni at the reunion dinner.
normal.cn: 她在 reunion 晚宴上见到老校友。

normal.en: The university invites alumni back every spring.
normal.cn: 大学每年春天邀请校友返校。

normal.en: Distinguished alumni gave talks to current students.
normal.cn: 杰出校友给在读学生做讲座。

normal.en: Compare alumnus: one person, not the group.
normal.cn: 对比 alumnus：指一个人，不是群体。

abstract.en: Picture a hall of people wearing the same badge.
abstract.cn: 想象礼堂里一群佩戴同样校徽的人。

abstract.en: Imagine a list of names kept by a school for decades.
abstract.cn: 想象学校保存了几十年的名单。

abstract.en: Think of one person called alumnus standing among many alumni.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人被称作 alumnus，站在众多 alumni 中。

examples.en: The alumni funded a new laboratory.
examples.cn: 校友们出资建了一间新实验室。

examples.en: Alumni from the class of two thousand still meet yearly.
examples.cn: 那一届的校友至今每年聚会。

examples.en: Alumni relations offices track graduates for decades.
examples.cn: 校友关系办公室会跟踪毕业生几十年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「a + lum + ni」——一群被「喂养」过的人回来报恩，就是校友；只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 alere（滋养）→ alumnus（被抚养者、学生）→ 复数 alumni（校友），核心义「学校培养过的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Alumni names former students, then the graduate body, then a disputed singular use.
sensesIntro.cn: alumni 先指已毕业的学生，再指毕业生群体，最后是受争议的单数用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crowd wearing the same school badge.
core.cn: 核心意象：戴着同一枚校徽的一群人。

branches.en: Former students are the core sense.
branches.cn: 已毕业学生是核心义项。

branches.en: The group read as one body is the collective use.
branches.cn: 作为整体来读是集合用法。

branches.en: Singular use is the disputed extension.
branches.cn: 单数用法是受争议的延伸。
个人与共同体总是重叠。

branches.en: Both relax the Latin plural rule.
branches.cn: 两者都松动了拉丁复数规则。

intro.en: Alumni rests on the Latin nourishing verb alere.
intro.cn: alumni 建立在拉丁语「滋养」动词 alere 上。

latinIntro.en: Latin alere gives alumnus, alumni, and aliment.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 alere 给出 alumnus、alumni、aliment。

items.example: Alumni is the plural used in English.
items.exampleCN: 英语用 alumni 作复数。

definition_zh: 先修课程；前提条件；先决资格；逻辑前提
definition_en: a course or condition that must be completed or met before something else is possible
core_image: 一扇锁着的窄门，钥匙挂在你上一门课的成绩单上
scene: 选课时，系统提示必须先修完基础课才能注册高级课。The system refused the request because the prerequisite course was not finished.
sceneCN: 这里 prerequisite 是「先修课程」（第 1 个义项：修高级课之前必须先完成的课程）；句意：系统拒绝了申请，因为那门先修课程还没有修完。

pos.zh: 先修课程；前提条件；先决资格

derivatives.zh: 同词根动词，义为「需要；要求」
prerequisite 去掉前缀后的基础词，义为「必需品」
由 require 加名词后缀构成，义为「要求；必要条件」

senses.title: A course to finish first
senses.definition: a course that a student must pass before taking a more advanced course
senses.definitionCN: 学生在选修更高级课程之前必须通过的课程
senses.example: Statistics is a prerequisite for the advanced methods course.
senses.exampleCN: 统计学是高级方法课的先修课程。
senses.why: Pre- means before and requirere means to demand, so the word names what is demanded beforehand.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 pre- 表示「在前」，requirere 意为「要求」，所以这个词指事先被要求具备的东西。

senses.title: A necessary condition
senses.definition: something that must exist or happen before something else can
senses.definitionCN: 在别的事情能够发生之前必须存在或发生的事物
senses.example: Trust is a prerequisite for any honest negotiation.
senses.exampleCN: 信任是任何坦诚谈判的前提条件。
senses.why: The before image moves from courses to any condition that has to come first.
senses.whyCN: 「在前」的意象从课程扩展到任何必须先具备的条件。

senses.title: A required qualification
senses.definition: a qualification or document required before a person is admitted or hired
senses.definitionCN: 在被录取或录用之前必须具备的资格或文件
senses.example: A clean driving record is a prerequisite for the delivery job.
senses.exampleCN: 无违章的驾驶记录是这份配送工作的先决资格。
senses.why: Institutions turn the condition into a formal gate that applicants must pass.
senses.whyCN: 机构把条件变成一道正式的门槛，申请人必须先通过。

senses.title: A premise in reasoning
senses.definition: an idea or fact that must be accepted for an argument or theory to hold
senses.definitionCN: 一个论证或理论要成立就必须被接受的观点或事实
senses.example: The theory treats stable prices as its prerequisite.
senses.exampleCN: 该理论把稳定的物价当作它的逻辑前提。
senses.why: Reasoning also has steps that come first, so the word serves logic as well.
senses.whyCN: 推理同样有必须先立住的前提，于是这个词也用于逻辑领域。

intro.en: Prerequisite joins Latin pre-, before, with requisitus, the past participle of requirere, to seek or demand.
intro.cn: prerequisite 由拉丁语 pre-（在前）与 requirere（寻求、要求）的过去分词 requisitus 组合而成。

items.en: Quaerere means to seek, the root inside requirere.
items.cn: quaerere 意为寻求，是 requirere 内部的词根。

items.en: Requirere means to seek again or to demand.
items.cn: requirere 意为再度寻求或要求。

items.en: Requisitus means sought out or required.
items.cn: requisitus 意为被寻求的、被要求的。

items.en: Pre- adds the sense of coming before.
English coins prerequisite from pre- and requisite.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语用 pre- 与 requisite 组合出 prerequisite。

items.en: Modern usage extends it from courses to any prior condition.
items.cn: 现代用法把它从课程扩展到任何先在条件。

note.en: Prerequisite shares the Latin root of require and requisite, and stands near condition and qualification.
note.cn: prerequisite 与 require、requisite 共享拉丁语词根，并与 condition、qualification 意义相邻。

entries.definition: a condition that must come first
a skill or document that fits a person for a role
something that must be true for something else

normalIntro.en: Prerequisite is pre- plus requisite, literally what is required before.
normalIntro.cn: prerequisite 就是 pre- 加 requisite，字面意思是「事先被要求的东西」。

normal.en: Split it as pre-, before, and requisite, required.
normal.cn: 拆成 pre-（在前）与 requisite（被要求的）来记。

normal.en: Require is the verb, and requirement and requisite are its family.
normal.cn: require 是动词，requirement 与 requisite 是同族词。

normal.en: A prerequisite course must be finished before the next course.
normal.cn: 先修课程必须在下一门课之前修完。

normal.en: Prerequisite knowledge is what you must already know.
normal.cn: prerequisite knowledge 指你必须已经掌握的知识。

normal.en: Say it as pre plus requisite, and keep the stress on reKWI.
normal.cn: 把它读成 pre 加 requisite，重音落在「奎」上。

abstract.en: Picture a locked gate with a key hanging from the last course you passed.
abstract.cn: 想象一道锁着的门，钥匙挂在你上一门通过的课程上。

abstract.en: Picture a row of dominoes: nothing moves until the first one is pushed.
abstract.cn: 想象一排多米诺骨牌：第一块不推倒，后面都动不了。

abstract.en: Picture a ticket window that opens only when a document is shown.
abstract.cn: 想象一个窗口，只有出示了文件才会打开。

examples.en: The prerequisite for the seminar is one course in statistics.
examples.cn: 这门研讨课的先修要求是一门统计学课程。

examples.en: Students must complete all prerequisites before registering.
examples.cn: 学生必须先修完所有先修课程才能注册。

examples.en: Clear goals are a prerequisite for steady progress.
examples.cn: 明确的目标是稳步进步的前提条件。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「普瑞奎斯特」——听成「先备齐才快」，把 prerequisite 想成事先备好的条件；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 pre-（在前）+ requirere（寻求、要求，源自 quaerere「寻求」）→ requisite（必需之物）→ 英语 prerequisite；核心义「事先被要求的条件」。

sensesIntro.en: Prerequisite starts as a course required before another course, broadens to any necessary condition, then a formal qualification, and finally a premise in reasoning.
sensesIntro.cn: prerequisite 起初指修另一门课之前必须先修的课程，随后扩展到任何必备条件、正式资格，最后指推理中的前提。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a locked gate whose key is the step you must finish first.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道锁着的门，钥匙就是你必须先走完的那一步。

branches.en: The required course is the campus sense.
branches.cn: 必修课程是校园里的常用义项。

branches.en: The necessary condition is the general sense.
The formal qualification is the gatekeeping sense.
branches.cn: 正式资格是筛选把关的义项。

branches.en: The premise is the reasoning sense.
branches.cn: 前提是推理层面的义项。

branches.en: Both a course and a condition must be settled before the next step.
branches.cn: 课程与条件都必须在下一步之前完成。

intro.en: Prerequisite is built from Latin pre- plus requirere, and the same family gives require, requisite and requirement.
intro.cn: prerequisite 由拉丁语 pre- 与 requirere 构成，同一词族还给出 require、requisite 与 requirement。

latinIntro.en: Latin pre- means before, and requirere means to seek or demand, from quaerere, to seek.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 pre- 意为在前，requirere 意为寻求、要求，源自 quaerere（寻求）。

items.example: Pre- marks what must come earlier.
items.exampleCN: pre- 标记必须先发生的事。

items.example: Quaerere is the root inside requirere.
items.exampleCN: quaerere 是 requirere 内部的词根。

items.example: Re- adds the idea of seeking again.
items.exampleCN: re- 加上「再次寻求」的意思。

items.example: Requisitus is the participle behind requisite.
items.exampleCN: requisitus 是 requisite 背后的分词。

items.example: Requisite is the base that pre- attaches to.
items.exampleCN: requisite 是 pre- 所附着的词基。

items.example: Prerequisite adds the before sense to requisite.
items.exampleCN: prerequisite 给 requisite 加上「在前」的意思。

items.example: Require is the everyday verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: require 是这个词族里的日常动词。

definition_zh: 成绩单；文字稿；抄本；转录本
definition_en: an official record of grades earned by a student, or a written copy of spoken words or of a document
core_image: 一张盖章的纸，把上过的课、得过的分数与说过的话一字不差地搬下来
scene: 申请研究生时，学生需要请学校把在校成绩密封寄出。The applicant asked the registrar to send an official transcript to the graduate school.
sceneCN: 这里 transcript 是「成绩单」（第 1 个义项：记录学生课程与成绩的官方文件）；句意：申请人请教务人员把一份官方成绩单寄给研究生院。

pos.zh: 成绩单；文字稿；抄本；转录本

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「转写；转写文本」
由名词转为动词，义为「把口头内容写成文字；抄录」
由 transcript 加酶类后缀构成，义为「转录酶」

senses.title: An official academic record
senses.definition: an official document listing the courses a student has taken and the grades earned
senses.definitionCN: 列出一名学生修过的课程与所得成绩的官方文件
senses.example: The graduate school asked for an official transcript with the application.
senses.exampleCN: 研究生院要求随申请提交一份官方成绩单。
senses.why: Latin transcriptum is a thing written across, a copy; the school copy of a student record became the transcript.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 transcriptum 指「抄写过来的文本」，即副本；学校抄存的学生记录就成了成绩单。

senses.title: A written record of speech
senses.definition: a written copy of words that were spoken, such as an interview or a lecture
senses.definitionCN: 把说出口的话写下来的文本，如访谈或讲座的记录
senses.example: Reporters checked the interview transcript before printing it.
senses.exampleCN: 记者在刊印前核对了访谈文字稿。
senses.why: The copy sense narrows to speech written down word for word, so talk becomes a fixed text.
senses.whyCN: 「副本」的意思收窄到把讲话一字不差地写下来，于是口语变成了固定文本。

senses.title: A written copy of a document
senses.definition: a copy of a legal or official document written out from the original
senses.definitionCN: 依原件抄写而成的法律或官方文件副本
senses.example: The archive keeps a transcript of the old charter.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆保存着那份旧宪章的抄本。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: a document written across from another document and kept as proof.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：从另一份文件抄写过来、留作凭据的文本。

senses.title: A gene copy made of RNA
senses.definition: a molecule of RNA produced when a gene is transcribed, carrying its message
senses.definitionCN: 基因被转录时生成的、携带其信息的一段核糖核酸
senses.example: The cell produced a transcript of the gene within minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 细胞在几分钟内就生成了该基因的转录本。
senses.why: Molecular biology borrows the writing image: a gene is copied into a working text.
senses.whyCN: 分子生物学借用「抄写」的意象：基因被抄录成一份可供使用的文本。

intro.en: Transcript joins Latin trans-, across, with the root of scribere, to write; a transcript is writing carried across from a source.
intro.cn: transcript 由拉丁语 trans-（穿过、越过）与 scribere（写）的词根组合而成，本义是「从某个来源抄写过来的文字」。

items.en: Trans means across, and scribere means to write.
items.cn: 拉丁语 trans 意为穿过、越过，scribere 意为书写。

items.en: Scriptum is a thing written, the participle form of scribere.
items.cn: scriptum 意为写下来的东西，是 scribere 的分词形式。

items.en: Transcriptum names a copy written out from an original.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 transcriptum 指依原件抄写出来的副本。

items.en: English takes transcript for a written copy of a document.
items.cn: 近代早期英语用 transcript 指文件的书面副本。

items.en: American colleges apply the word to the official grade record.
items.cn: 十九世纪美国高校把这个词用于官方成绩记录。

items.en: Modern English also names speech written down and a copy of a gene.
items.cn: 现代英语还用它指写下来的讲话与基因的转录本。

note.en: Transcript pairs trans- with the writing root, next to transcribe and transcription, and it sits near the record words of school and court.
note.cn: transcript 把 trans- 与表示「写」的词根配在一起，与 transcribe、transcription 同根，也与学校与法庭的记录类词相邻。

entries.definition: to write down words or copy a record
the act or product of transcribing
an official document that proves something

normalIntro.en: Trans- means across and script means writing, so a transcript is writing carried across from one page or one voice to another.
normalIntro.cn: trans- 意为「越过」，script 意为「写」，所以 transcript 就是从一页纸或一段话「抄写过来」的文本。

normal.en: A transcript of a course lists the grades you earned.
normal.cn: 课程的成绩单列出你得到的分数。

normal.en: An interview transcript writes down every word that was said.
normal.cn: 访谈文字稿把说过的每句话都写下来。

normal.en: Transcribe is the verb, transcription is the act or the finished text.
normal.cn: transcribe 是动词，transcription 是动作或成品。

normal.en: The same writing root gives script, describe and manuscript.
normal.cn: 同一个表示「写」的词根还给出 script、describe 与 manuscript。

normal.en: Compare certificate: a certificate proves a fact, a transcript lists grades.
normal.cn: 对比 certificate：证明书证明某个事实，成绩单列出各科分数。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed sheet of grades sliding into an envelope.
abstract.cn: 想象一张盖章的成绩单滑进信封。

abstract.en: Picture a recorder turning sound into lines on paper.
abstract.cn: 想象录音机把声音变成纸上的一行行字。

abstract.en: Picture a clerk copying a page from an old book into a new one.
abstract.cn: 想象书记员把一页旧书的内容抄到一本新册子上。

examples.en: You must order an official transcript for each application.
examples.cn: 每份申请你都要单独申请一份官方成绩单。

examples.en: The transcript of the hearing runs to forty pages.
examples.cn: 这场听证会的记录长达四十页。

examples.en: Reporters checked the interview transcript before printing it.
examples.cn: 记者在刊印前核对了访谈文字稿。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿斯克瑞普特」——把课堂表现「穿」成文字，再盖章成成绩单；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过、越过）+ scribere（写）→ 中世纪拉丁语 transcriptum（抄出的副本）→ 英语 transcript；核心义「抄写下来的文本」，故有成绩单、文字稿、抄本与转录本。

sensesIntro.en: Transcript starts as a copy written out from a document, narrows to speech written down, widens to the official school grade record, and is borrowed for a gene copy in biology.
sensesIntro.cn: transcript 先指依文件抄出的副本，再收窄为写下来的讲话，又扩大为学校的官方成绩记录，最后被借指生物学中的基因转录本。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a page copied across, word for word, and sealed.
core.cn: 核心意象：把内容一字不差地抄到另一张纸上，再盖章。

branches.en: The school record is the everyday sense for applicants.
branches.cn: 学校记录是申请人最常遇到的义项。

branches.en: Speech written down extends the copy to talk.
branches.cn: 把讲话写下来，把「副本」扩展到口语。

branches.en: The document copy is the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 文件副本是最古老的义项。

branches.en: The gene copy borrows the image for biology.
branches.cn: 基因转录本把这一意象借给了生物学。

branches.en: Both a grade sheet and a speech record are copied text.
branches.cn: 成绩单与讲话记录都是抄写而成的文本。

intro.en: Transcript joins Latin trans-, across, with scribere, to write; the same parts build transcribe, transcription, script and manuscript.
intro.cn: transcript 由拉丁语 trans-（穿过）与 scribere（写）构成；同样的部件还构成 transcribe、transcription、script 与 manuscript。

latinIntro.en: Latin trans means across and scribere means to write; transcriptum is a copy written out.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trans 意为穿过，scribere 意为书写；transcriptum 指抄写出来的副本。

items.example: The root -script- appears in transcript and scripture.
items.exampleCN: 词根 -script- 出现在 transcript 与 scripture 中。

items.example: Transcriptum passes into English as transcript.
items.exampleCN: transcriptum 进入英语成为 transcript。
